column1: #   kind     block = the sample MUST be reported by the named pattern
#            allow = the sample MUST NOT be reported by ANY pattern
#   sample   literal text, one line, written exactly as it would appear in an
#            evidence file (encoded and escaped forms included verbatim),
#            except that each home root is a <<NAME>> token. This file is
#            tracked and must hold no literal home path (#145 Part A), so
#            readers expand the sample with expand_vector_tokens() in
#            (VECTOR_TOKENS); an unknown or malformed token is an error.
# >= 1 block and >= 1 allow vector; every vector runs through the CLI tree
# scan, the --range history scan and the pre-commit hook.
# This file lives outside docs/evidence/, so it is never scanned itself.
